technical.summary: Bullish structure with EMA golden cross and price above all major MAs, but overbought stochastic/Williams %R and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; moderate confluence without strong volume confirmation.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar headwind for energy multinationals, and earnings event in 29 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above all major moving averages provides classic bullish structure, and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) presents contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic (84.71) and Williams %R combined with weak ADX (17.75), zero fundamental support, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (322.4), and earnings binary risk in 29 days create excessive downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows EMA golden cross and price above major MAs, but overbought conditions (stoch 84.71, Williams %R) combined with weak ADX (17.75) signal pullback risk rather than continuation. Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity, but macro headwinds and earnings binary in 29 days eliminate margin of safety.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (322.4), and upcoming earnings event create severe downside risk that far outweighs technical bullish structure; overbought momentum extremes likely to trigger pullback before any upside realization.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian angle but insufficient to override macro and earnings risks
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MPC position with 12 other Energy positions in 196-stock portfolio; adding concentration in high-volatility sector during macro crisis and earnings proximity violates risk discipline.
